name: Finger Gun Tabs
description: Point a finger gun at your webcam and shoot your open tabs closed. Everything runs on your computer.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
